== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English [[DS-61-3]] and [[DS-61-3 (Errata)]] articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata. Do not transclude onto Unlimited, Japanese, Two-Player, foil, or (V). {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous filled cell.
